rows.name: getOverflowAriaLabel
rows.description: Builds the overflow trigger aria-label from hidden count.

rows.name: getItemAriaLabel
rows.description: Builds the accessible name for every breadcrumb item (visible and hidden), carrying its position within the full trail (e.g. "Level 3, breadcrumb 3 of 6"). This is how screen readers announce the correct count/position given the component's flex layout removes native list semantics.
